title: thymus jankae subsp. imbricatus
intro: Thymus jankae subsp. imbricatus, commonly known as Balkan thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus jankae plant, a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it has been used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Balkan thyme include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Thymus jankae subsp. imbricatus include thymol, carvacrol, and other terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
